Package model

Class OrderManager

java.lang.Object
model.OrderManager
public class OrderManager extends Object
Manages creation, conversion, and lifecycle of orders in the system. This class is responsible for maintaining the current order list, assigning order IDs, converting Dtos into domain objects, and delegating state changes to OrderListCurrent.
